pawnMexicoCity.columnNote: Values were read from a multi-column PDF via text extraction; the pairing of 'Costo total' vs 'Tasa de interés' rows is inferred from layout (interest annual = 12 x monthly checks out).
pawnMexicoCity.vat: All pawn operations exempt from IVA.
pawnMexicoCity.refrendo: Extends the contract term by paying the interest accrued by the due date shown on the contract; anyone holding the contract may pay it.
pawnMexicoCity.desempeno: Redeem by paying principal plus accrued interest by the due date; only the holder.

fees.lateRedemption: 5% per month of outstanding loan balance, charged once
fees.custodyIfRedeemedButNotCollected: 2% of avalúo per calendar month after the first 30 days; uncollected items kept up to 365 days then forfeited
fees.exhibition: 5% per calendar month in exhibition, on outstanding balance

pawnMexicoCity.default: Items neither redeemed nor renewed are put up for sale (comercialización). Surplus (demasía) = sale price - loan - accrued interest - late charges; claimable within 365 calendar days of the sale notice, with the contract.

pawnVancouver.item: Criminal rate of interest (Criminal Code s.347) from 2025-01-01
Pawnbroking exemption, Criminal Interest Rate Regulations SOR/2024-114 s.2
pawnVancouver.value: exempt from the 35% cap if: pawnbroking business; credit against tangible personal property other than a vehicle; only recourse on default is seizure of the pawned item; credit advanced < CAD 1,000 AND APR <= 48%
pawnVancouver.derived: Pawn loans < CAD 1,000: max 48% APR. Pawn loans >= CAD 1,000: max 35% APR.

pawnVancouver.item: City of Vancouver Secondhand Dealers and Pawnbrokers By-law No. 2807: hold period
pawnVancouver.value: 49 business days after purchase (handwritten register), or as advised by the Chief Constable, not exceeding 90 days
pawnVancouver.why: bylaw PDF behind Cloudflare/403; from search excerpt. Also: pawned and purchased goods must be physically separated and tagged; register copy to VPD daily by 10:30 a.m. (excerpt).

pawnVancouver.item: Named shop: CCE Pawn (Charlie's Currency Exchange), 827 Granville St, Vancouver
pawnVancouver.interestMonthly: 5% on loans above CAD 1,000; 10% on loans below CAD 1,000
pawnVancouver.graceDays: 7 days past expiry for one extra month's interest
pawnVancouver.renewal: at shop's discretion by paying accrued interest at 3 months
pawnVancouver.default: items usually sold back to the pawner, if available, at 150% of principal
pawnVancouver.caveat: 10%/month (~120% APR) on loans under CAD 1,000 exceeds the 48% APR exemption ceiling in force since 2025-01-01; the page may predate the change.

prevalenceApr2025-Mar2026.unit: % of vehicle-owning households victimised once or more

whereIncidentsOccurred.source: Nature of crime: vehicle-related theft, year ending March 2025 — Tables 2b (theft of vehicles) and 2c (theft from vehicles)
whereIncidentsOccurred.definition: Note 10: 'Semi-private' includes outside areas on the premises and garages or car parks around but not connected to the home. ('Private' is not defined in the notes; read as inside a garage/building connected to the home.)

whereParkedOvernight.source: NTS0908: Where vehicle parked overnight by rural-urban classification of residence: England
whereParkedOvernight.publisher: Department for Transport, National Travel Survey
whereParkedOvernight.date: last updated 2025-08-27 (data year 2024; next update summer 2027)
whereParkedOvernight.unit: % of household vehicles, England, 2024 [break in series]
whereParkedOvernight.note: Question not asked every year; excludes cases where location was not known (note 3). Tables also by rural-urban class back to 2002.

derivedRiskByLocation.method: rate per 1,000 vehicle-owning households (YE Mar 2025) x share of incidents at that home location / share of vehicles parked there overnight (NTS 2024). Mapping assumed: CSEW home-private ~ NTS garage; home-semi-private ~ NTS private property not garaged; home-street ~ NTS street.
caveats: The garage figure for theft OF vehicles rests on ~14 unweighted incidents and an uncertain mapping (CSEW 'semi-private' also includes unconnected garages); treat as unreliable.
CSEW is England and Wales; NTS0908 is England only.
NTS shares are per vehicle; CSEW rates are per vehicle-owning household (a household may own several vehicles).
About 33% of thefts of and 20% of thefts from vehicles happen away from home (work/other), not attributable to overnight parking.
